verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM publishes its Developer API as an OpenAPI 3.0.0 document (67 /v1/ paths) in the official repository, downloadable as raw JSON. Each self-hosted or desktop instance also serves it via Swagger UI at /api/docs. The 404 probes on the docs site show only that the spec is not hosted there; they do not contradict its availability. Missing for 10: a canonical spec URL on the vendor docs site, independent hands-on corroboration of downloading and using the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: AnythingLLM publishes its Developer API as an OpenAPI 3.0.0 document in the official repository (67 paths, all under /v1/)
You can find the API documentation for available endpoints on your instance at /api/docs
